The formula

Keratin, ginseng extract and coconut oil in a dual-chamber bottle. Shampoo and conditioner stay separate until your ritual begins.

How to use

Shampoo: apply to wet scalp and hair, massage gently for 2 to 3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly. Conditioner: apply to the lengths only, leave for 5 to 8 minutes, then rinse well.

Key ingredients

Hydrolysed keratin, ginseng extract, coconut oil, rice water, argan oil, milk protein, arginine and salicylic acid.
